description: Perpetuals universe metadata from Hyperliquid's public info API ({"type":"meta"}) — every perp contract Hyperliquid lists (currently 190+), each with its symbol, szDecimals (size precision), maxLeverage, and isDelisted when retired. This is the reference list to resolve a human-asked symbol ("BTC", "ETH", "SOL") to a contract Hyperliquid actually trades before calling hyperliquid_mids, hyperliquid_l2_book, hyperliquid_candles or hyperliquid_funding_history with it — those all take the bare coin symbol shown here (e.g. "BTC", not "BTC-PERP"). Pass `coin` to look up one symbol instead of the full list.

coin.description: Optional — filter to one perp symbol, e.g. "BTC" or "ETH". Omit to list the whole universe.

name: hyperliquid_perp_meta
